description: Athlete reports doctor-ordered complete rest for the week — Dean must set plan_action.injury_hold and NOT prescribe running sessions.

user.name: Elena
user.injury_notes: IT band tightness, started this week

inbound_sms: Bad news — saw the doctor this morning and she said no running this week. IT band is inflamed and she wants complete rest. Really frustrated but going to listen.

ground_truth.notes: PRIMARY TEST: Dean must set plan_action.injury_hold = true on the deliver_message call. The athlete has received explicit doctor's orders for complete rest — this is the clearest possible plan_action.injury_hold trigger. Dean must NOT prescribe any running session. Dean SHOULD acknowledge the frustration, validate listening to the doctor, and suggest cross-training/rest. Dean may mention the race is still achievable. If plan_action.injury_hold is set and no running is prescribed: score 10. If plan_action.injury_hold is not set OR any running session is prescribed: score 0. Tone and wording otherwise are secondary.
